# Dr. Woof Apparel AU

> > Premium Australian-designed medical scrubs and healthcare apparel combining comfort, style, and sustainability for medical professionals.

Dr. Woof Apparel is an Australian retailer specializing in quality medical uniforms, scrubs, and healthcare accessories for nurses, doctors, and other medical professionals. The brand offers themed collections including Disney's Winnie the Pooh designs, sustainable planet-friendly options, and a wide range of scrub styles with a focus on comfort and functionality.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare apparel

## Featured Collections

- [Disney's Winnie the Pooh Scrubs & Accessories](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/collections/disney-collection): Disney Winnie the Pooh themed scrubs, compression socks and healthcare accessories collection featuring beloved characters like Tigger, Eeyore, and Piglet.
- [Blue Scrubs Collection](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/collections/blue-scrubs): Blue scrubs collection featuring Australian-designed medical uniforms for men and women.
- [Planet Friendly Scrubs Collection](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/collections/planet-friendly-scrub-uniforms): Sustainable scrub uniforms made from recycled materials for eco-conscious medical professionals.

## Scrubs & Uniforms

- [Women's High-Waisted Flare Scrub Pants](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/products/womens-flare-scrub-pants): Women's high-waisted flare scrub pants with elastic waist and sweat-wicking fabric for all-day comfort.
- [Scrub Caps for Nurses](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/collections/scrub-caps): 100% cotton scrub caps in 40+ joyful prints with mask-holding buttons for nurses and doctors.

## Accessories & Accessories

- [Headbands for Healthcare Professionals](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/collections/headbands): Comfortable, sweat-wicking headbands with mask buttons designed for healthcare professionals.
- [Scrunchies for Healthcare Professionals](https://www.drwoofapparel.com.au/collections/scrunchies): Fashionable hair scrunchies collection for healthcare professionals with themed designs.
